title: A website is a business decision. We treat it like one.

items.title: One small team, start to finish
items.body: The people who scope your project design and build it. Nothing is lost in a handoff, and you always know who to call.

items.title: Fixed scope, fixed price
items.body: We write down what is included before we start. If the scope changes, you see the cost first and decide.

items.title: Built to be found and to be fast
items.body: Semantic markup, optimized images and lean code, so pages load quickly and search engines can read them.

items.title: No lock-in
items.body: Standard tools, plain documentation and full handover. You can keep working with us or take it in-house.

principles: Show work early. You see progress every week, not at the end.
Keep the stack boring. Proven tools beat clever ones.
Write for visitors first, search engines second.
